text: The trigger is mine and I concede its context. in_zone:ma_20 is valid only inside a rising tide: weekly first (C21), a rising average over the pullback (C9, C10). W swing_class LH/LL with ma50 104.9 < ma100 107.84 < ma200 108.61 is not a rising tide; it is the transitional ground where Elder takes nothing (C22). elder_5d [10, 7, 10, 7, 7] has no transition. I stand aside. Clearing: W swing_class HH/HL with weekly_trend_direction UP (R6, not served to me), then in_zone:ma_20 on D with elder 7 or higher. Until then the ticket should not carry my trigger as a buy.
what_moved_me: ma50 104.9 < ma100 107.84 < ma200 108.61 and W swing_class LH/LL: the averages over the pullback are falling, so C10's rising-average leg fails and C22 says stand aside.
